answer: To verify a tundra survey from a rock ledge to a jetty, assign each identity a seat backed by a distinct deposit. Before each round, verifiers check that every deposit is locked through the appeal window and backs just one seat. Two signatures from the same seat on conflicting readings for the same assignment prove equivocation and forfeit its bond. With a 50-credit bond per seat, 100 aliases tie up 5,000 credits at once.
